documents.title: FIA 2026 Formula One General Regulatory Provisions

passages.text: Race points depend on final classification and the leader's officially counted laps. The leader must complete two entire consecutive laps without a Safety Car or Virtual Safety Car procedure for any points to be awarded.
The full-points distance band begins at 75% of the Scheduled Race Distance. The first-position entry in that band is 25 points, subject to the article's opening eligibility condition.
For a race dead heat, the points for the tied positions are pooled and divided equally among those sharing the tie.
A published provisional race classification can be amended under the governing FIA rules; it is not by itself proof of the final points recipient.

provisions.summary: Race points require the prescribed consecutive leader laps and final classification.
provisions.applicability: Formula One 2026 race points under the fetched Section A Issue 03. Historical issue applicability and actual event lap evidence have not been established.
exceptions: Fewer than two qualifying complete consecutive leader laps means no points under this condition.
provisions.discretion: No independent discretion to replace the points table is established by this passage; actual decisions require separate evidence.

provisions.summary: A sole first-place finisher receives 25 points in the full-points distance band.
provisions.applicability: Formula One 2026 race, final sole first-place classification, leader distance at least 75% of Scheduled Race Distance and the required consecutive laps without SC/VSC. This is a conditional rule, not an event award.
exceptions: Below 75% distance uses other bands, not this 25-point value.
A dead heat requires A2.2.3 rather than the sole-winner value.
Sprint allocation is outside this profile.
provisions.discretion: Penalties, appeals or decisions changing classification or an award need their own reviewed evidence. Missing decision evidence does not establish that none exists.

provisions.summary: Tied race positions share the combined points equally.
provisions.applicability: A race dead heat under the fetched 2026 Section A Issue 03; not a season standings tie-break.
exceptions: The sole-winner 25-point answer cannot be applied unchanged to a tie.
provisions.discretion: The actual tie and classification require official event evidence.

provisions.summary: Provisional classification remains subject to amendment.
provisions.applicability: Formula One 2026 classification under fetched Section B Issue 08. It does not prove historical applicability to a named event.
exceptions: A provisional finishing order may differ from the final result.
provisions.discretion: Review the applicable decision and final classification; this passage does not predict officials' decisions.

profile.value: Conditional 2026 Formula One rule: a sole full-points race winner receives 25 points. Full points require at least 75% scheduled distance and the prescribed two consecutive complete leader laps without SC/VSC. Final classification, no dead heat, and applicable decisions must be established before applying this to an event. No historical issue applicability is inferred.
